title: Three Women at Cabin, 1947 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 74 Julia Peikeman Emily Dawson Virginia Dromavich July 26-47
description: A black and white snapshot from July 26, 1947, showing three young women—identified on the back as Julia Peikeman, Emily Dawson, and Virginia Dromavich—sitting on a stone terrace in front of a rustic cobblestone and wooden cabin. The women are dressed in classic mid-1940s summer attire, including high-waisted shorts, blouses, and rolled hairstyles, reflecting post-WWII American recreational life and leisure culture.
